segments.text:
V. 13.
Wo to you—Our LORD pronounced eight Bleſſings upon the Mount: He pronounces eight Woes here: Not as Imprecations, but ſolemn, compaſſionate Declarations of the Miſery, which theſe ſtubborn Sinners were bringing upon themſelves. Ye go not in—For ye are not poor in Spirit; and ye hinder thoſe that would be ſo.
